exercises.q: The mouse ran under the bed.
exercises.why: **забежала** — забежа́ть (perfective): to get by running or as if by running; to run ahead (in anticipation), to run before someone; (colloquial) to visit, to drop in. Wiktionary: за- + бежа́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to run (to; as far as), to reach
incursion, raid, foray (of barbarians, nomads, gangs, etc.)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: добежа́ть — to run (to; as far as), to reach; избе́гнуть — to avoid, to refrain from; набе́г — incursion, raid, foray (of barbarians, nomads, gangs, etc.); неизбе́жность — inevitability.

exercises.q: The boat is full of refugees.
exercises.why: **беженцами** — бе́женец: refugee; asylum seeker (one who seeks asylum). Wiktionary: бе́гать + -енец.
